request.spec:
People can be pasted in as lines of name,grade into an import box. All the lines are checked
first, with the same rules as the form: an empty name, a grade other than A, B or C, a name
already on the sheet, or a name repeated in the paste (compared like uniqueness) is an error. If
any line has an error, nothing is imported and each bad line is marked with its line number;
otherwise every person is added, in order, each with a PERSON_ADDED line in the audit, and the
count added is shown.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
People can be pasted in as lines of name,grade into an import box. All the lines are checked
first, with the same rules as the form: an empty name, a grade other than A, B or C, a name
already on the sheet, or a name repeated in the paste (compared like uniqueness) is an error. If
any line has an error, nothing is imported and each bad line is marked with its line number;
otherwise every person is added, in order, each with a PERSON_ADDED line in the audit, and the
count added is shown.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The import box is in, and `bin/e2e` passes.

**Server:** a new endpoint, `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/people/import`, takes the pasted text.
- `CheckImport` checks every line before saving anything, using the same rules as the form. A line is an error if the name is empty, the grade isn't A, B or C, or the name is already on the sheet or repeated in the paste. Names are trimmed and compared ignoring case, as the form does.
- If any line is bad, nothing is imported. The server refuses the request (400) and sends back the numbers of the bad lines. Nothing is saved and no audit line is written.
- Otherwise everyone is saved in the order pasted (`SaveImport`). Only after all are saved does `AuditImport` write one `PERSON_ADDED` line each, so a refused import never leaves audit lines behind. The reply carries the count added.

**Front end:** the box is in a new file, `features/people/import.slot.tsx`, shown next to the People panel.
- It shows the count added (`import-added`) and marks each bad line with `import-error-<line>`.
- Results clear as soon as you edit the text or submit again. The people list reloads after a successful import.
- To show the bad line numbers, I changed the shared error type in `api/http.ts` so it keeps the server's reply when a request is refused.

Two things I decided that the request didn't cover:
- **Blank lines** are skipped, but line numbers still count them, so the numbers shown match the pasted text.
- **Line format:** a line is split at its first comma; a line with no comma counts as having no grade, so it's an error.
